title: Preserve event logging and protocol behavior

context.hint: Handle serialization failures after client JSON parsing without losing the session server.
context.surface: An authenticated session server serializes client events for logs and local event storage.
assumptions: A client must hold the session credential.
Use a disposable local authenticated session and bounded test inputs.

review.invariant: Serialization failure handling preserves valid event records and ordinary session protocol behavior.
review.verification: Check that ordinary events still serialize and that a failed serialization cannot append malformed event data. Run the authentication, server and WebSocket protocol suites.

source_observation.summary: The repair used a bounded log marker and skipped unserializable persisted records. The three targeted suites passed with 86 tests in total. Results cover the local session fixture.
